route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour and Human Welfare)

permit.applies: The work permit is issued under guidelines of the Ministry of Labour and Human Welfare; who files it is in those guidelines (Legal Notice No. 80/2003), not reached.

sources.title: Labour Proclamation No. 118/2001, Gazette of Eritrean Laws vol. 10 no. 5 (15 November 2001), art. 8 (FAOLEX scan; quoted from its OCR text layer, errors as printed there)
sources.said: Article 8. Work Permits for Non-nationals ( I) Non-nationals may not work in Eritrea without a valid work penn it issued in accordance with guidelines issued by the Ministry.
